file_roles.evidence: alphaMapBoundingBox now returns glyph_metrics_t() when rect.left == rect.right || rect.top == rect.bottom; before it returned margin-only metrics for empty glyphs so the glyph cache requested an invalid image.

rationale: The font engine reported a non-empty bounding box for an empty glyph, and the texture glyph cache then tried to paint an invalid image, producing the QPainter warnings. The correction is in the font engine.
